name: JTL Defence Limited
about: JTL Defence Limited manufactures and sells non-ferrous metal products in India and internationally. The company offers aluminum products, including aluminum, household, pharmaceutical, and container foils, as well as high content aluminum electric conduction; brass; and bronze products, such as aluminum bronze and phosphor bronze strip and coil. It also provides copper products comprising electrolytic tough pitch, deoxidized highly reduced phosphorous, and tin bearing; copper foils, copper sheets, and copper wires; nickel silver and cupro nickel; nickel silver 104 and nickel silver 106; tin solder; and stainless-steel products. The company serves customers across electrical and power, infrastructure, automotive, industrial, renewable energy, and defence-related applications. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as RCI Industries & Technologies Limited and changed its name to JTL Defence Limited in February 2026. JTL Defence Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.
